intro: KENT Sapphire IoT is one of the most advanced RO water purifiers, featuring an intelligent RO + UF + UV + Alkaline + Copper + TDS Control purification system that delivers 100% pure, safe, and healthy drinking water. It effectively removes bacteria, viruses, chemicals, heavy metals, and dissolved impurities such as arsenic, rust, pesticides, and fluorides while meeting IS:10500 drinking water standards. The purifier is equipped with IoT-powered smart monitoring that provides real-time information on water quality, filter life, and purifier performance through your mobile device. It also supports automatic service call registration, timely filter and membrane replacement notifications, and complete service and parts replacement history for maximum convenience. Its advanced TDS Control technology retains essential natural minerals, while Active Copper Technology enriches purified water with the goodness of copper. The integrated Alkaline Technology delivers mineral-rich water with a pH level between 8.0 and 9.5, helping regulate the body's pH balance, reduce acidity, support immunity, and promote overall wellness. A smart Digital Display provides real-time information on water quality, filter life, and RO flow rate. The UV LED Light inside the storage tank continuously purifies the stored water to prevent bacterial growth and maintain long-lasting freshness. With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and an 8 litre storage tank, it ensures an uninterrupted supply of purified water even during power outages. Backed by a 1 Year Warranty and 3 Years Free Service, KENT Sapphire IoT is trusted by more than 1 crore satisfied consumers across India. It has received numerous national and international awards and is certified by both BIS and NSF, ensuring world-class quality, safety, and long-lasting performance.
